{{Quote|The Jeedai thought to use the knowledge of our chosen race to remake the galaxy. But I poisoned their attempts.|Zenoc Quah|<ref name="Legacy 44" />}}
'''Zenoc Quah''' was a member of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[shaper caste]] who lived during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and in the aftermath of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]], surviving well into the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Quah helped to [[Vongspawn virus|sabotage]] the [[Ossus Project]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Everything is pain, Jeedai. Lovely, lovely pain.|Zenoc Quah to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>}}
Unlike many other [[Yuuzhan Vong]], Zenoc Quah believed that surrender to the [[New Jedi Order|"Jeedai"]] and their allies was a betrayal. A self-declared "''true'' Yuuzhan Vong," Quah escaped the dying [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] around [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to land on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and viewed the others who had left for [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] as traitors and heretics. When [[Darth Maladi]] of the [[One Sith]] collaborated with Quah to [[Vongspawn virus|sabotage]] the [[Ossus Project]], preventing Yuuzhan Vong [[Shaping protocol|techniques]] from being used by the inhabitants of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Legacy 44" />

[[File:DeathofZenocQuah.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Zenoc Quah is killed.]]
While the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] was torn apart by [[Sith–Imperial War|war]], Quah remained on the [[Vongspawn]]-infested Wayland and continued to experiment on its native life on a [[Wayland Yuuzhan Vong laboratory|laboratory]] once employed by the Ossus Project. By [[137 ABY]], the shaper was [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] a weapon intended to bring greater devastation to the galaxy at large.<ref name="Legacy 44" /> Quah collaborated with the Sith Lords Darth Maladi and [[Darth Nihl]] to [[Wayland trap|trap]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and his companions.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

After capturing [[Deliah Blue]], Quah tormented her using the [[Embrace of Pain]] while Maladi implanted a malevolent Vongform onto Blue's back. Maladi sought to turn Skywalker into a weapon that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] could use to keep the other Sith in check.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

When [[Jariah Syn]] arrived with [[Wolf Sazen]] and [[Fionah Ti]], Maladi ordered Quah to release their experiments, defend the lab, and kill the intruders. In the ensuing fighting, Skywalker's companions subdued Quah's experimental Vongforms. After Quah refused Ti's order to surrender, Zenoc Syn used his [[Heartstriker|amphistaff]] to kill Quah.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

Unable to overcome Skywalker, Maladi fled after setting the remote detonation that destroyed the laboratory within minutes. With his companions safely evacuated, Skywalker succeeded in freeing Blue from the bioweapon that Quah and Maladi had implanted on her back by using the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] her.<ref name="Legacy 46" />
